🔄 Content update (Published: November 27, 2026 / Previously posted: October 28, 2026)
Main change: Alert period changed to November 27 – December 6, 2026 (Reiwa 8). Of the 5 fatal accidents this period, cargo trucks were involved in 4 cases. Deaths include 3 pedestrians crossing at crosswalks and 2 cyclists (including one person in their teens).

Saitama Prefecture has issued a traffic death alert following 5 fatal accidents occurring between November 24–26, 2026 (Reiwa 8).

Alert period: November 27, 2026 (Friday) through December 6, 2026 (Sunday) — 10 days total.

Key features of the 5 accidents:
• Cargo trucks (such as lorries) involved in 4 of the 5 cases
• 3 deaths: pedestrians crossing at crosswalks
• 2 deaths: cyclists (1 in their teens)

To drivers: Please obey speed limits, give priority to pedestrians at crosswalks, use high-beam headlights at night, watch for people crossing from the right, drive considerately around elderly road users, and turn on headlights early.

To pedestrians: Use crosswalks and pedestrian bridges, look both ways and signal with your hand, wear reflective materials or carry lights at dusk/night/early morning, and wear bright clothing.

We call on all road users to heighten awareness and protect precious lives.

Source (Japanese): https://www.city.hanno.lg.jp/soshikikarasagasu/shiminseikatsubu/jinkenkurashianzen/bohan/7837.html
